batched_window_generator.note: Reuses the preregistered ledger stream prefix; concurrency is not an input to event generation, so identical ledgers are paired across every concurrency and policy.

hardware_topology.placement: even source ranks use same-node Peer-HBM/local DRAM; odd ranks use cross-node Peer-HBM/remote DRAM; both mappings are bijective

workload.slack_predictor: independent registered output distribution v1; never reads realized output or realized service
workload.same_universe_rule: For a fixed concurrency and workload seed, both policies receive byte-identical tasks including predicted slack; the canonical hash includes all task fields and predicted_slack_ms.

capacity.pressure_transition_basis: C=1/2 are below the controller active>2 pressure condition; C=4 crosses it; C=8/16 also exceed the seven-request no-backup capacity bound. This grid is derived before execution and is not selected from outcome shape.

failure_exposure.duplicate_semantics: a hit on an already-down worker/node is ledgered as no-op until repair and never reapplies damage
failure_exposure.zero_event_memoization: exact executed equivalence gate per concurrency/policy/seed
failure_exposure.estimator: arithmetic mean of actual independent window samples including every zero-event window; event-bearing windows execute the full persistent multi-event DES

statistics.primary: all-workflow WCT mean; AegisKV relative gain versus paired Native Mooncake
statistics.seed_estimator: within each workload seed, arithmetic mean of the registered window-level statistic
statistics.ci: two-sided paired Student-t 95% CI across the ten workload seeds
statistics.resource_metrics: actual DES time-integrated serving-HBM, Peer-HBM backup, and DRAM occupancy plus peaks; alpha/pressure sampled at the three registered controller steps
statistics.sanity_metrics: event/no-op/domain counts, admission/rejection/residency, copy-byte conservation, reclaim, capacity violations, no-oracle, reuse=0

figure_grammar.kind: three failure-rate facets with concurrency curves; never a heatmap
figure_grammar.panel_a: all-workflow mean WCT gain percent with paired 95% CI
figure_grammar.panel_b: AegisKV final alpha and pressure fraction
figure_grammar.panel_c: AegisKV mean serving-HBM, Peer-HBM backup, and DRAM occupancy

gate.purpose: structure, exact-zero, capacity, resource-integration, and hash pairing only; no performance direction gate

hard_gates: all source file hashes match preregistration
all registered cells and seeds retained including negative/degraded regions
ledger generated and hashed before policy replay
ledger hash identical across policies and concurrency for each seed/rate/window
workload universe hash identical across policies for each seed/concurrency
zero-event injected DES exactly equals healthy DES
event-bearing windows execute persistent multi-event state machine
all workflow IDs retained in every window
copy byte conservation and asynchronous independent path semantics hold
no capacity violations and no realized-output oracle
exactly three registered controller opportunities execute for AegisKV
actual occupancy integrals are nonnegative and Peer-HBM plus serving never exceeds the shared budget
reuse_fraction remains exactly zero and no shared-prefix reuse is inferred
no performance win or monotonicity threshold
evidence_boundary: Preliminary metadata DES. A100 bandwidths, 500 ms activation, and 60 s replacement/repair are modeled and unmeasured. Native Mooncake is a modeled Router+Store approximation. Ten paired workload seeds quantify workload uncertainty; Poisson windows are actual samples, but this is not physical evidence.
